modality: RGB previous/current frames + binaural audio; no depth
action_handling: raw deterministic actor argmax directly to Env.step; no adapter or overrides
selection: Stage NLL shortlist and predeclared epoch checkpoints; screen all on fixed 100 validation episodes per split by max min(heard_SPL/0.25,unheard_SPL/0.15), tie mean SPL then stable lexicographic candidate order; fully evaluate the top-ranked candidate on all 500 validation episodes per split and freeze only after predeclared point-SPL gates pass; otherwise continue validation-only iteration. Test is final and never guides later tuning.
test_policy: freeze model, checkpoint, config and source hashes before complete 1000+1000 test; test results cannot drive subsequent changes
reference: original validation-selected offline_d_corrective, not later test-guided versions
conflicting_earlier_artifacts: archived, excluded from candidate selection; wrong pure-RGB modality
runtime_concurrency: screening and collection: maximum 4 simultaneous simulators; after all training/collection ends full validation: 8 simultaneous simulators (4 per split); final test: 8 simultaneous simulators (4 per split). Four fixed identity partitions and same policy protocol throughout.
final_selection_amendment_reason: Declared before any full validation or test access: use one ranked finalist to reserve input-token budget for complete validation and complete final tests.
